messages:
maria: Quick follow-up on the metering RFC. We've been seeing orphaned tokens in chunked/streamed requests where final billing events lack handshake provenance. Proposal: a tiny "token-proof" sidecar written at handshake time that downstream consumers can join on. Minimal fields: req_id, tenant_id, prefix_fingerprint, handshake_ts, schema_v. Open to alternatives.

sam: Sketch the write path? worried about adding sync work on hot path.

maria: Plan: piggyback on existing handshake ack path. Async write to a separate compacted topic (metering-sidecar). Upsert semantics, TTL for short retention. Measured p95 write impact <1ms on staging.

kyle: If sidecar arrives after billing events, how do we avoid losing attribution? need a reconciliation/fill path?

maria: Two fallbacks: 1) realtime join if sidecar exists before event; 2) deferred reconciler that matches late sidecars within a window (e.g., 7d) and emits provenance-repair audit events to patch accounting.

jess: From audit/product: auditors want deterministic proofs for billing windows. Late attribution is okay if we emit explicit repair events and mark invoices provisional until reconciliation. Can we add an audit marker? :thinking_face:

maria: Yes — reconcile patches emit a provenance-repair audit event containing original_event_id, claimed_attribution, and confidence (exact | best-effort). Billing can then apply adjustments and surface provisional flags.

sam: Example sidecar payload?

maria: ```json
{
  "req_id": "r_01Fabcd",
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "prefix_fp": "sip64:0xdeadbeef",
  "handshake_ts": 1719999999,
  "schema_v": "v1"
}
```

kyle: Concern: prefix_fp collision risk at scale. Need collision-resistant approach for ~1e9 tokens. siphash64 keyed per-tenant + short sha256 prefix? compute cost adds to client though.

maria: Tradeoff: use siphash64 (cheap) keyed per-tenant for storage/indexing, plus include a 16-byte sha256 prefix for cross-tenant uniqueness when needed. Sidecar size increases but still small.

sam: Ops: single compacted topic per region or multi-tenant single topic partitioned by tenant hash?

maria: Single topic partitioned by tenant-hash is operationally simpler. Configure compact + TTL 7d (configurable). Reconciler only considers sidecars within TTL.

jess: Audit retention required 90+ days. Sidecar TTL 7d seems short; how do we keep compliance trails?

maria: Sidecar is ephemeral join helper. Reconciliation and all provenance-repair audit events are written to the immutable audit log which has 90+ day retention for compliance. So sidecar TTL can be short without losing auditability.

sam: How do consumers perform joins? exact req_id match or prefix_fp lookup?

maria: Prefer req_id exact match. For chunked flows without req_id, fallback to prefix_fp match. Join ranking: req_id exact -> tenant+prefix exact -> time-window best-effort. Reconciler will backfill matches when sidecar is late.

kyle: Dedup/at-least-once: if sidecar produced multiple times, reconciler/accounting must be idempotent. Suggest canonicalize sidecar and write-if-not-exists via compacted keying.

maria: Agreed. Sidecar key = req_id if present, else prefix_fp + handshake_ts_bucket. Writes are upserts to compacted topic; duplicates are safe.

ingest-bot: metering-sidecar prototype deployed to staging: metering-sidecar:v0.1 -> staging (2024-11-05T03:12:00Z) :rocket:

sam: Add microbenchmarks for write latency and topic throughput and include in RFC follow-up.

maria: Will add benchmarks and cost estimate (storage + egress). Initial estimate: ~0.2 bytes/token overhead on average plus small per-handshake entry.

jess: Product wants dashboard flagging per-tenant late-attribution >0.5%.

maria: Telemetry plan: per-tenant late-attribution rate, reconcile success rate, repair event volume. Default alert threshold 0.5%.

sam: Operational runbook? If sidecar topic lags, how avoid invoice drift?

maria: Runbook: consumer lag SLOs, alert on >5s p95 lag. Emergency fallback: mark invoices provisional and pause finalization until reconciler/repair completes.

maria: Decision summary: 1) Implement compacted sidecar topic (metering-sidecar) with small envelope (req_id, tenant_id, prefix_fp, handshake_ts, schema_v). 2) Async upsert writes on handshake; key = req_id or prefix_fp+bucket for idempotency. 3) Sidecar TTL default 7d; audit/repair events retained 90+ days in audit log. 4) Reconciliation job patches late attribution and emits provenance-repair audit events (confidence flagged). 5) Telemetry and alerts for late-attribution (>0.5%). I'll open PR with bench results and cost numbers. :thumbsup:
